issue_context.title: openssl dgst print the digest in coreutils format
issue_context.body:
$ openssl dgst -help
Usage: dgst [options] [file...]
  file... files to digest (default is stdin)
 -r                  Print the digest in coreutils format

$ openssl dgst -r -sha256 123.txt 
181210f8f9c779c26da1d9b2075bde0127302ee0e3fca38c9a83f5b1dd8e5d3b *123.txt
$ sha256sum 123.txt 
181210f8f9c779c26da1d9b2075bde0127302ee0e3fca38c9a83f5b1dd8e5d3b  123.txt

$ echo 123 | openssl dgst -r -sha256
181210f8f9c779c26da1d9b2075bde0127302ee0e3fca38c9a83f5b1dd8e5d3b *stdin
$ echo 123 | sha256sum 
181210f8f9c779c26da1d9b2075bde0127302ee0e3fca38c9a83f5b1dd8e5d3b  -

There is a little bit different from coreutils tools commands.
1. no '*' , just two spaces.
2. replace 'stdin' with '-'
